name: apocryphon-monorepo
description: Apocryphon — skill store and manager for coding agents (CLI + core engine)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @apocryphon/core && npm run build -w @apocryphon/cli
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @apocryphon/core --silent && npm run typecheck -w @apocryphon/core && npm run typecheck -w @apocryphon/cli
scripts.test: npm run build -w @apocryphon/core --silent && node --import tsx --test packages/core/test/*.test.ts packages/cli/test/*.test.ts
